description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying log messages in a LogView within a ScrollView. It provides the UI setup and manages updates to show logs dynamically. The class interacts with Android framework classes such as Fragment, View, and related UI components.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView wrapped inside a ScrollView. It initializes and configures the UI components to display logs, and updates the view to scroll to the bottom whenever the log text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applying layout parameters, styling, padding, and adding the LogView to the ScrollView. Returns the root ScrollView containing the log display.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method called to create and initialize the fragment's view hierarchy, adding a TextWatcher to automatically scroll to the bottom when log text updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within this fragment for additional interactions.
